column_description: Unique identifier for each scene-object relationship.
ID of the scene the object belongs to. may be NULL.
ID of the object within the scene. may be NULL.
Role of the object within the scene (e.g., main character, background). always exactly one of 'main character', 'background'. may be NULL.
Start time of the object's role in the scene. may be NULL.
End time of the object's role in the scene. may be NULL.
Status of the object within the scene (e.g., active, inactive). always exactly one of 'active', 'inactive'. may be NULL.
ID of the user who added the object to the scene. may be NULL.
ID of the user who last updated the object's role in the scene. may be NULL.
Flag to indicate if the object's role in the scene is active. may be NULL.
